seo.title: Aluminium Gates & Paving — Gdańsk and Pomerania | StalBruk
seo.description: Laser-welded aluminium gates, fences and automation, manufactured and installed. Block paving, earthworks and turnkey projects with our own machinery. Free site survey and quote within 24 hours.
seo.ogTitle: StalBruk — aluminium gates and block paving in Pomerania
seo.ogDescription: One crew, one deadline: laser-welded gates, paving and earthworks with our own equipment. Gdańsk, Gdynia, Sopot and the surrounding region.

hero.h1: Aluminium gates and block paving — one crew, one deadline
hero.lead: We design, manufacture and install laser-welded gates. We lay block paving and handle earthworks with our own machinery — so you are never waiting on a subcontractor.
hero.microcopy: We reply within 24 hours. Survey and quote at no cost, no obligation.
hero.imageAlt: Modern aluminium sliding gate with horizontal infill in front of a family house near Gdańsk

items.label: subcontractors — we do it all in-house

pain.title: Sound familiar?
pain.lead: The three things we hear most often from customers before they come to us.

items.quote: The crew vanished after taking the deposit.
items.answer: A written contract with a deadline, a schedule and staged payments. The final instalment is due only after handover.

items.quote: The deadline has slipped three times already.
items.answer: The excavators, the crew and the workshop are ours. We are not waiting for a subcontractor to free up.

items.quote: The gate rusted through after two winters.
items.answer: We build in aluminium. Coastal damp and salt have nothing to bite into.

services.title: What we do
services.lead: Three areas that are most often ordered together — which is exactly why one crew handles all of them.

items.title: Gates and fencing
items.desc: Sliding, swing and industrial gates, wickets and fencing. Automation, remotes and video intercom.
items.imageAlt: Aluminium sliding gate with automation opening

items.title: Block paving
items.desc: Driveways, terraces, car parks and paths. Concrete block, granite setts and large-format slabs.
items.imageAlt: Driveway laid in grey block paving in a herringbone pattern in front of a garage

items.title: Turnkey projects
items.desc: Earthworks, ground levelling, relocation of poles and utility connections, drainage. Our own excavators.
items.imageAlt: Excavator preparing the ground for a driveway and fencing

why.title: Why us
why.lead: Four reasons customers choose us over the cheaper quote from the classifieds.

items.title: It will not rust. Ever.
items.desc: Aluminium instead of steel. Five coastal winters leave it untouched — nothing to sand back or repaint every season.

items.title: Welds that will not open up
items.desc: Laser welding instead of MIG: accuracy measured in tenths of a millimetre and a seam you can barely see.

items.title: One contractor instead of four
items.desc: The excavator operator, the paver, the welder and the fitter are all us. No juggling four crews and four calendars.

items.title: A quote broken down line by line
items.desc: You see what you are paying for — materials, labour and machinery listed separately. Any change of scope is agreed with you before the work, not after.

process.title: How it works
process.lead: Four steps from your first call to the finished job.

steps.title: Enquiry
steps.desc: You leave your phone number. We call back and ask a few questions about the scope.

steps.title: Free site survey
steps.desc: We come out, take measurements and check the ground, the access route and the utility runs.

steps.title: Quote and contract
steps.desc: You receive an itemised quote and a completion date confirmed in writing.

steps.title: Installation and warranty
steps.desc: We build it, clear the site behind us and hand over the warranty documents.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: If something is missing here, give us a call — we will answer on the spot.

items.q: How much does a gate cost?
items.a: It depends on the dimensions, the infill and the automation. A sliding gate for a family house starts at {{CENA_BRAMA_OD}} PLN. We give an exact figure after the free site survey — without one, any number would be guesswork.

items.q: How long does a project take?
items.a: Usually {{TERMIN_TYGODNI}} weeks from survey to installation, depending on the season and the scope. The date is confirmed in writing in the contract.
Gdańsk, Gdynia, Sopot and the whole Pomeranian Voivodeship. For larger jobs we travel further — ask and we will check.
{{GWARANCJA}} years on the structure and the welds. Automation is covered by the manufacturer's warranty — {{GWARANCJA_AUTOMATYKA}} years.
No. The survey and the quote are free and place you under no obligation to order.
In stages: a deposit for materials, a portion on delivery and the balance after handover. We never ask for the full amount up front.
Yes. We own our excavators, so levelling the ground, moving a pole, running a utility connection or installing drainage is part of the same job rather than a separate subcontractor.

Aluminium does not corrode, and on the coast that matters — salt-laden damp eats through steel gates in a few seasons. An aluminium gate needs no repainting and is lighter, so the automation lasts longer before it fails.
